---
title: "The Bond Films"
jupyter: python3
---

```{python}
#| echo: false
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

films = pd.read_csv("films.csv")

bond = films[films["franchise"] == "James Bond"]
```

## James Bond Films

The first James Bond film in the dataset was released in `{python} int(bond["year"].min())`, and the last was released in `{python} int(bond["year"].max())`.

## Revenue Over Time

@fig-bond-revenue shows how James Bond box office revenues have changed over time.

```{python}
#| label: fig-bond-revenue
#| fig-cap: "Worldwide Box Office Revenue of James Bond Films Over Time"
#| echo: true

plt.plot(bond["year"], bond["revenue_musd"])
plt.xlabel("Release Year")
plt.ylabel("Worldwide Revenue (Million USD)")
plt.title("James Bond Revenue Over Time")
plt.show()
```
